reviews.t: Removing gel polish has never been so easy
reviews.x: This product is amazing.  It makes an easy job of removing gel polish.  I followed the directions by filing the surface of the nail bed first and then applied the product, waited 3 minutes and then applied another coat.  After waiting 3 more minutes, I was able to peel off the gel polish with a cuticle stick.  It makes removing gel polish so much easier!  I love this product.

This stuff is much better than any other remover method! Less messy, way faster, and no odor! I normally use remover pads and soak my nails. I tried this gel remover and am hooked! It only takes a few minutes to remove any polish and dip powder. It even removes nail tips! I like that you can control where you apply it as well. You can 'spot remove' with this stuff!

I was destroying natural nails just peeling off my gel polishes but thankfully this works and is fast. I file the top coat down on my nails first then apply this remover wait a few minutes and then do another layer and use my nail scraper and this stuff just takes the gel off so easy. My natural nails are doing much better now thanks to this.
I wish I found this sooner! So much easier to remove gel polish. Now I can save time and money by doing my own nails!

To use: I buffed off the top coat with a file and then painted some on each finger. If the polish didn't "burst" after 5 minutes,  I added a second coat. (I only had to add a second coat to 4 fingers) To scrap off I used a cuticle pusher and it came off super easy. Note to self - don't do it in the living room, I made a

I just started using gel polish and only because this product exists. I don't see how this can be more harmful than acetone, in terms os toxicity is probably the same as soaking you fingers on solvent for 20min. Anyway, I noticed that the gel brand makes a difference on how many layers you'll have to apply, maybe one, maybe two or even three (glitter took me three). It works. Yes it is a chemical compound, as is everything you apply on your nails.

I have tried several brands of this type of remover and this is by far the best.  I like that I don't have to file the polish off before using.  Just apply, wait, apply, wait and buff nails.  I had stopped using gel polish for a while because of how difficult it is to remove but this product is a game changer.  I have been using the nail polish for several months and this is my new favorite brand.

reviews.t: Works great when you give it time to work!
reviews.x: I have recently started using builder gel and it has improved the length of my gel manicures like crazy! Only con is it is extremely difficult to get off. I purchased this to help and I feel like it works great! You really have to give it time to sit and then remove the top layer then apply again. It takes some practice but eventually you figure it out!

This product makes the nail polish easy to remove. I waited around 10 minutes and didtn't touch anything... suprisingly the nail polished started ti flake on its own. Then, I pushed it a little and it came off easily. I hadn't had this result using any other product. I don't usually write reviews, but this product worth it.

claims.text: Most reviewers find the product easy to use and effective at removing gel polish, often in just a few minutes.
Many reviewers note it is fast and saves time and money compared to salon visits or other removal methods.
Several reviewers mention it has no odor and is less messy than acetone or soaking methods.
Some reviewers say multiple applications or filing the top coat first are needed, and one found the product goopy and slow.
A few reviewers report it does not burn or hurt, though one reviewer says it wrecked and split their nails.
